name: The Kings Head
accommodation: En-suite inn rooms in several types, including suites and king rooms
suitableFor: Couples and small groups who want a pub base
beachAccess: In Llangennith village; no distance stated by the inn
confirmedFeatures: En-suite rooms, tea and coffee making, in-room cooler, TV, underfloor heating, pub food and drink
overview: The Kings Head is a 17th-century inn in the middle of Llangennith village, inland from the north end of Rhossili Bay. Its rooms are all en-suite with underfloor heating, and the pub downstairs means food and a drink are on hand after a day on the beach.
surfTripFit: It puts you in the village closest to the Llangennith peak, with a pub and meals under the same roof.
